summary: Okanogan NF summit in Okanogan County, WA: a D-6 cupola cabin of 1922, destroyed or removed in 1974; gone, with only wire and nails left in 2020.

facts.status_note: Destroyed in 1974 per FireLookout.com and Willhite; the register says removed that year. A snow pole stood in 2001, and Willhite found nothing much left but wire and nails in 2020.

access.note: Willhite drove Forest Service roads and hiked to the summit in May 2020; none of the sources read mention a closure or permit.

visit.trail_note: Drive Forest Service Road 3825 for 6 miles to the unsigned trail start, then hike 1.6 miles one way with 1,200 feet of gain (Willhite).

events.note: D-6 cupola cabin built in 1922; a 1922 entry quoted by Forest Lookouts says a standard house was built that October
FireLookout.com lists Bert Julian as known lookout personnel for 1923; this conflicts with the 1924 date
Bert Julian was the lookout, per Willhite and an October 1924 item quoted by Forest Lookouts (radio reception)
Panoramic images taken from the cupola second-story windows
FireLookout.com lists Robert McIntosh as known lookout personnel
Cab destroyed after 52 years per Willhite and FireLookout.com; the register says removed in 1974
A pole for measuring snow still stood on the site as of September 12, 2001
Registered in the Former Fire Lookout Sites register as US 683, WA 17
Willhite visited in May 2020: nothing much left but wire and nails

resolved_conflicts.explanation: FireLookout.com lists Julian for 1923 and 1929. Willhite and an October 1924 item quoted by Forest Lookouts give 1924. The story uses 1924 and notes the other dates.
The register says the cabin was removed in 1974. FireLookout.com and Willhite say it was destroyed in 1974. The story reports both.

notes_for_editor: Julian's dates conflict across sources; the story uses 1924 because two sources agree. The access level public is an inference from Willhite's 2020 visit with no closure mentioned, not a stated rule. No height is given in any source.
